newLicense.subheadline: Your step-by-step guide to earning your first Swiss driver's license

steps.title: Eye Test
steps.description: Get your vision checked by an authorized Swiss optician. They will stamp your learner's permit application (valid for 24 months).

steps.title: First Aid Course
steps.description: Attend a mandatory 10-hour course to learn basic life-saving skills and how to secure an accident scene (valid for 6 years).

steps.title: Apply for Learner's Permit
steps.description: Submit your application to your canton's Road Traffic Office along with your eye test, first-aid certificate, and a passport photo.

steps.title: Pass the Theory Test
steps.description: Study the Swiss traffic rules and take the multiple-choice theory test (available in several languages).

steps.title: Get Learner's Permit
steps.description: After passing the theory exam, you get your learner's permit. With it, you can begin driving practice under supervision.

steps.title: Driving Lessons & Mandatory VKU Course
steps.description: Start practical driving lessons with an instructor (recommended, not legally required). You must also attend the VKU hazard awareness course before the practical exam.

steps.title: Practical Driving Exam
steps.description: Take the road test with an official examiner. If you pass, you move on to the probation period.

steps.title: Probationary License (3 Years)
steps.description: You receive a provisional license valid for 3 years. During this period, you must complete an additional WAB training day. After 3 years (assuming no major traffic violations), you get the full Swiss driving license.

foreignLicense.subheadline: A simple, 4-step guide to exchanging your existing driver's license for a valid Swiss one

steps.title: Register your foreign license
steps.description: Apply at your cantonal road traffic office within 12 months of arriving in Switzerland.

steps.title: Submit required documents
steps.description: Provide your original license, a translation (if not in a recognized language), your ID/residence permit, and an eye test.

steps.title: Take a control drive (if required)
steps.description: Some countries require a practical test (“Kontrollfahrt”), while others (like EU/EFTA countries) usually do not.

steps.title: Receive Swiss license
steps.description: Your foreign license is exchanged for a Swiss one (and is usually kept by the authorities).

servicesDetails.title: Category B Driving Lessons
servicesDetails.description: Professional, patient, and modern driving lessons in safe training cars
servicesDetails.detailedContentTitle: Personalized Driving Lessons for Every Level
servicesDetails.detailedContent:
Whether you are a complete beginner or already have some experience, our instructors adapt each lesson to your pace and learning style.
You will learn parking, maneuvering, city driving, highway driving, hazard awareness, and exam-relevant techniques.
We prioritize calm instruction, modern teaching methods, and clear feedback so that your progress feels consistent and stress-free.
Automatic and manual cars are available.
servicesDetails.pricingDetailsDescription: Lessons are billed per session. A package of 10 lessons includes the 11th lesson for free. Payment can be made per lesson or in advance for the discounted package.

seo.title: Category B Driving Lessons | Dualisa Driving School
seo.description: Professional driving lessons in Bern for beginners and experienced learners. Automatic/manual, patient instructors, exam preparation.

servicesDetails.title: First Aid Course
servicesDetails.description: Learn how to react in emergency situations and recieve the official certificate
servicesDetails.detailedContentTitle: What You Learn in the First Aid Course
servicesDetails.detailedContent:
Our First Aid Course teaches you the essential skills needed to act confidently and responsibly in emergencies. The course follows official Swiss guidelines and covers accident response, life-saving techniques, resuscitation (CPR), wound care, and how to secure the accident site.
At the end of the course, you will receive the official Nothelfer certificate, required for your learner's permit application. Our classes are clear, practical, and suitable for complete beginners.
servicesDetails.pricingDetailsDescription: Price includes all course materials and the official certificate required for your learner’s permit in Switzerland. Payment is due at the time of registration.

seo.title: First Aid Course | Nothelfer Certificate for Learner's Permit
seo.description: Swiss first aid course with official certificate. CPR, accident response, wound care – required for your driving license application.

servicesDetails.title: Theory Test Preparation Course
servicesDetails.description: Prepare efficiently for the Swiss theory exam with structured lessons, clear explanations, and practice questions that help you understand road rules instead of memorising them
servicesDetails.detailedContentTitle: Master the Swiss Traffic Rules with Confidence
servicesDetails.detailedContent:
This course guides you through all essential topics of the Swiss theory exam. We explain traffic rules, signs, priorities, dangers, and safe driving behavior in a simple, structured way.
You'll practice with official question formats, learn strategies to avoid common mistakes, and understand the logic behind each rule. The goal is not only to pass the exam but to build a strong foundation for your practical driving lessons.
servicesDetails.pricingDetailsDescription: The price is per lesson and can be paid individually. Students may book as many sessions as needed to prepare for the Swiss theory exam.

seo.title: Theory Test Preparation Course | Swiss Driving Exam Prep
seo.description: Structured course for the Swiss theory exam. Learn traffic rules, signs, and safe driving behavior with practice questions.

servicesDetails.title: Traffic Study Course (VKU)
servicesDetails.description: The mandatory VKU course that teaches you how to recognize dangers, read traffic situations, and drive proactively — an essential step before the practical exam
servicesDetails.detailedContent:
In this course, you learn how to assess traffic situations, identify risks early, and adapt your driving to weather, traffic, and road conditions.
The VKU is required by Swiss law before you can register for the practical driving test.
Our course is taught with real examples, videos, and interactive exercises so you can understand how to drive defensively and safely in everyday situations.
servicesDetails.pricingDetailsDescription: This is a fixed price for the complete VKU course. Payment confirms your seat and must be completed before the first session.

seo.title: Traffic Study Course (VKU) | Mandatory Swiss Driving Test Requirement
seo.description: Mandatory VKU course for the Swiss practical driving test. Learn hazard detection, defensive driving, and situational awareness.

servicesDetails.title: Completion Course (WAB)
servicesDetails.description: Complete the mandatory WAB training day required during your 3-year probation period to obtain your full Swiss driving license
servicesDetails.detailedContentTitle: Your Final Step to the Full License
servicesDetails.detailedContent:
After receiving your probationary license, Swiss law requires you to attend the WAB completion course within three years.
In this training, you improve your advanced driving skills through controlled exercises on special training grounds.
You learn braking techniques, lane control, eco-driving, hazard management, and how to better understand your vehicle's limits.
Upon completion, you receive the certificate needed to convert your probationary license into a full Swiss license.
servicesDetails.pricingDetailsDescription: The price covers the full mandatory course day required during the probationary period. Payment is needed to secure your spot at the training center.

seo.title: Completion Course (WAB) | Full Swiss Driving License Step
seo.description: Mandatory WAB course for probationary license holders. Advanced driving skills, braking, lane control – get your full Swiss license.

servicesDetails.title: Special Programs for Seniors and Anxious Learners
servicesDetails.description: Gentle, patient, and individually adapted lessons designed for seniors, nervous beginners, and learners with specific needs
servicesDetails.detailedContentTitle: Supportive Training Tailored to Your Needs
servicesDetails.detailedContent:
This program is designed for learners who need extra guidance, reassurance, or a slower learning pace.
For seniors, we focus on refreshing traffic knowledge, adapting to modern traffic density, and building safe driving habits.
For anxious learners, we use calm, step-by-step methods to help reduce stress and increase confidence behind the wheel.
The goal is to create a comfortable and supportive learning environment where everyone can succeed.
servicesDetails.pricingDetailsDescription: This rate applies per lesson and includes personalized instruction tailored to the driver’s needs. Payment is made after each session unless otherwise arranged.
